method: closure of <a,b> under 2x2 matrix multiplication over Q(sqrt5)(i)
comparison: Closure of <a,b> under 2x2 matrix multiplication over Q(sqrt5)(i) compared with the recorded coordinate set under the brief's matrix map; the map checked as a homomorphism on all 14400 ordered pairs against an independently written Hamilton product; BFS shortest-word distances and histogram compared per vertex; every recorded word replayed to its endpoint and checked minimal.
checks_reported: generators are special unitary (det 1, dagger is inverse)
all 14400 ordered products stay in the closure
closure equals the recorded coordinate set
the record keeps q and -q distinct (SU(2), not the projective quotient)
matrix product agrees with the Hamilton product on all 14400 ordered pairs (map is a homomorphism)
all 120 elements are reached by the alphabet a,A,b,B
every recorded word replays to its recorded endpoint (right multiplication, written order)
every recorded word has the minimal length for its endpoint
the recorded collision aA = identity holds
shared_dependencies: Q(sqrt5) arithmetic on Fraction pairs is exact; both implementations rely on that.
The brief's matrix correspondence is taken as the definition of the matrix side; it is then checked to be a homomorphism.
Generators, conventions and coordinate encoding are read from the brief and the record, so an error in those definitions would be shared.
